SELECT ACCESS_ID AS LOG_ID, MEMBER_ID AS memberId, ACCESSED_AT AS accessedAt, IP_ADDRESS AS ipAddress, RESULT AS result, NVL(M.LOGIN_FAIL_COUNT, 0) AS failCount FROM ACCESS_LOG
AND ACCESSED_AT >= TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND ACCESSED_AT < TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1
AND IP_ADDRESS LIKE '%' || #{ipAddress} || '%'
ORDER BY LOG_ID DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY
